task.notes: One day ahead (test: two days). E10.5 hearts were dissected and E9.5 embryo portions sectioned, so this transition mixes development with a change in what was sampled (Data Protocol).

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

copy.what: real reference cells at the count rule

b0.what: B0 (feat-009): T1 chamber-only copy plus damped momentum; T2 copy plus damped momentum or bracket interpolation, both in count space

b0_depth.what: B0 on a T2 extrapolation board with its cells binomially thinned to the target's depth, extrapolated at B0's damping (half the latest log rate per day over the horizon)
b0_depth.rule: depth (extrapolation): the target's median counts per cell = d_ref * exp(damping * r * (target_day - ref_day)), r = (log d_ref - log d_start) / (ref_day - start_day), the latest log rate per day, at B0's damping; the reference's cells are binomially thinned by target / d_ref when the target lies below d_ref (counts are never added)
